summary: Iteration 8 — Real-data conversion (removed all mocks/hardcoded values) verified end-to-end. 14/14 pytest tests PASS. Backend dashboard/metrics + quick-stats return live DB values (total_subscribers=2, monthly_revenue=₱32.39, router_status={online:0,offline:1,error:0,total:1}, open_tickets=5, resolved_today=3, pending_payments=1). Quick-stats cards contain 'X / Y online' string for Router Uptime, real 'vs last month' change labels (+100% because prev month had zero baseline), no '+12%', '+8%', '99.9%', '1.2K' hardcoded strings anywhere. Demo user demo@ispbilling.local login correctly returns {status:'error', message:'Invalid credentials'} — migration removed the row. Admin login still works and returns a bearer token. HSGQ OLT: /hsgq-olt returns real (empty for current DB) list; /hsgq-olt/{uuid}/onts returns {success:true, data:[], notice:'ONT enumeration requires SNMP...'} — no fake John Doe/Jane Smith/AA:BB:CC:DD ONTs; /discover, /authorize (with valid payload), /reboot, /statistics all return HTTP 501 code:NOT_IMPLEMENTED; invalid OLT id returns 404. MikroTik router sync no longer returns 'Phase 5' placeholder — real RouterOS error 'Connection failed: Unable to establish socket session, Connection timed out' is returned with success:false and synced_items={dhcp_leases:0,queues:0,system:false} (expected because the seeded router 104.198.214.223 is unreachable from preview). Frontend /dashboard verified visually: no forbidden strings ('+12% from last month', '+8% from last month', 'Phase 3: Dashboard & Core UI - Complete') present; ₱ prefix present on Monthly Revenue (₱32.39) and Today's Revenue (₱32.39); metric cards populate from real API. Regression endpoints (customers, invoices, service-plans, tickets, payments) all 200.

minor.issue: When {oltId} is not a valid UUID string (e.g., 'nonexistent'), PostgreSQL throws 22P02 and Laravel returns HTTP 500 HTML page instead of a JSON 404/400. Real UUIDs work fine (404 when not found). Consider catching QueryException or validating the parameter with Route::pattern('oltId', UUID regex) or Str::isUuid() guard.

Returns 404 — this route does not exist. Only /reports/{revenue,customer-growth,payment-methods,service-plans,tickets} exist. Not a regression (pre-existing), but flagging in case the UI expects a summary endpoint.

ui_bugs.issue: Route /customer-login is still not wired to CustomerLoginPage.tsx. Not in scope of this task.

action_items: (Minor / defensive) In HsgqOltController::getOnts/discoverOnts/authorizeOnt/rebootOnt/getOntStatistics, wrap Router::find() with a UUID validity check or add Route::pattern('oltId', '[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}') to routes/api.php so non-UUID inputs return a clean 404/400 JSON instead of Laravel's 500 HTML page.

(Optional) Consider changing percentChange() to return null (instead of 100.0) when prev==0 AND curr==0-only-because-of-first-month, so the UI shows 'No prior data' on greenfield installs. Current +100% is acceptable but could be misleading on brand new deployments.
critical_code_review_comments: DashboardController real-data rewrite is clean: uses Carbon month boundaries, proper aggregates (whereDate/whereBetween), handles null baseline in percentChange helper. LGTM.
HsgqOltController correctly returns 501 + code:NOT_IMPLEMENTED for unimplemented actions and empty data with 'notice' string for getOnts — matches spec.
MikrotikService::syncRouter now returns real testConnection/getDhcpLeases/getQueues output; error surface is the RouterOS client's actual exception message — no placeholder text. Good.

AdminUserSeeder uses updateOrCreate (idempotent) and creates only Super Administrator. The 2026_07_02_190000_remove_demo_user migration successfully removed demo@ispbilling.local (verified: login returns 'Invalid credentials').
NewDashboardPage.tsx cleanly reads metrics.subscribers_change_pct / metrics.revenue_change_pct with (X ?? 0) fallbacks and formats ₱ via toLocaleString('en-PH'). No hardcoded strings remain.
